_note: SUPPLEMENT ONLY. Every value here comes from db.ascension.gg, a SECOND aowow snapshot of the same TrinityCore spell tables db.exil.es serves. It is namespaced under `ids` and must never be merged into a tools/spellchk/ record's top-level keys. Precedence is unchanged: in-game tooltip > db.exil.es > db.ascension.gg > coabuildhub > ascensionsidekick.

Fetched 2026-08-03 in 2018 HTTP requests: 1 robots.txt, 21 ?class=<12..32> listviews, 1864 full ?spell=<id> pages, 16 retries of transient 502s, 1 follow-up page (804811), 87 ?spell=<id>&power calls, 18 ?item=<id> reagent-name lookups, and 10 manual probes. Sequential, single-threaded, >=1.1s between requests, User-Agent identifying the project. ZERO 429 and ZERO 503 were seen -- the only failures were transient 502s (4 ids), of which 2 never recovered on either endpoint and are marked `_unreachable` rather than absent. robots.txt was re-verified the same day: only ?admin= ?account= ?compare= ?filter= ?go-to-comment= ?search= are disallowed, so ?class= ?spell= ?item= are all in policy. (tools/dbsearch.py targets ?search= and is therefore still off-policy -- untouched by this file, but still true.)

COVERAGE -- READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING AN ABSENT KEY. 5434 ids come from the 21 class listviews, which are the ONLY polite enumeration db.ascension.gg offers (its sitemap.xml is 108 category URLs and names no spells). Those listviews reach just 3038 of the 12005 ids in the tools/spellchk/ mirror = 25%. The other 8967 mirror ids -- rank stubs, procs, pet spells, triggered effects -- appear in NO class listview, and reaching them means one request each, which was out of scope and would be impolite. THIS FILE DOES NOT COVER THEM. A further 2396 ids here are Ascension-only and absent from the mirror entirely.

TIMING COMES FROM THE SERVER-RENDERED `spelldetails` GRID, NEVER A TOOLTIP -- except where `cooldown_src` says otherwise. ?spell=<id>&power ROUNDS: measured on 60 ids whose exact grid cooldown was already known, the tooltip was exact on 30 of 30 'N sec' values and wrong on 6 of 30 'N min' values, every miss being 90000ms rendered as '1 min'. So `cooldown_src: tooltip-seconds-exact` is safe, and `cooldown_ms_floor` is a LOWER BOUND that must never be written into a CD column as if it were exact.
AN ABSENT cooldown_ms KEY MEANS 'NOT FETCHED', NOT 'NO COOLDOWN'. Only ids whose `_src` contains "page" or "power" were ever asked. `_why` records why an id was selected for a page fetch.

`present: false` is the ~43-byte `registerSpell(<id>, 0, {})` empty-dict literal from ?spell=<id>&power -- db.ascension.gg has no such spell. HTTP 404 on the full page is NOT an absence signal (`page_404: true` records it): 681130 Mountain Hammer 404s on its page and still returns a complete tooltip. And absence here is a HINT about the live game, not a verdict -- 500148 Solar Burn, 560470 Distracto Shot and 560471 Hellgaze are all absent from Ascension and all three are recorded in resources/icon-missing.json as CONFIRMED IN GAME by a human on 2026-08-02.

`reagents: []` is a POSITIVE 'this spell needs none', observed in the listview. A missing `reagents` key means unobserved. Reagent item names came from ?item=<id>; 18 distinct items back all 19 reagent-bearing spells.

MERGE RULE (per FIELD, never per record, so a wrong Ascension row cannot corrupt a right exil.es one). name/description/effects/skill_line: exil.es ALWAYS wins, Ascension never overwrites. cooldown_ms/gcd_ms/cast_time_ms: FILL-ONLY -- take a value only where the mirror's is 0/null; where both are non-zero and differ, keep exil.es and log it. One such conflict exists today, 804811 Monstrous Howl/Hunger, mirror 40000ms vs Ascension 45000ms. reagents/advType/icon/trainable/present: Ascension-only, no conflict possible. mechanic_name/dispel_name: advisory cross-check only -- classify off the mirror's numeric ids.

USEFUL NEGATIVE RESULT: of the 1756 Ability/Talent rows whose mirror cooldown_ms is 0, only 70 gained a cooldown here (4.0%) -- the other 1683 render `Cooldown n/a` on Ascension too, which upgrades them from 'unknown zero' to 'corroborated zero' by a second independent snapshot. The earlier 27% estimate came from the raid-utility population, which skews hard toward pressed buttons; do not apply it more widely.

`name_conflict` holds the db.exil.es name where the two sources disagree AFTER stripping aowow's leading quality byte (^[@0-9]). exil.es always wins on name; the conflict is recorded for in-game triage, never applied.

DELIBERATELY NOT CARRIED: descriptions (Ascension leaves formulas unresolved -- '22+0+AP*0.310294'), effects (Ascension renders them as English prose while every utility_tables.py classifier keys on numeric effect_id/aura_id/mechanic/misc_value), spec names (Ascension has only numeric skill ids; the mirror's skill_line.name is already correct and costs nothing), any numeric damage/heal magnitude (the two snapshots do not reconcile -- 704258 reads 160 vs 40 Health -- and nobody has explained why), and COA PvP Mods (the site itself warns they are often wrong).
